passage.label: Al-Baqarah — seek help through patience and prayer; Allah is with the patient; do not say those killed in Allah's way are dead — they are alive but you perceive not; We will test you with fear, hunger, loss of wealth, lives, fruits; give glad tidings to the patient; who when disaster strikes say inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un; upon them are blessings and mercy from their Lord; they are the guided

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱسۡتَعِينُواْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
وَلَا تَقُولُواْ لِمَن يُقۡتَلُ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَمۡوَٰتُۢۚ بَلۡ أَحۡيَآءٞ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَشۡعُرُونَ
وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُم بِشَيۡءٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡخَوۡفِ وَٱلۡجُوعِ وَنَقۡصٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡوَٰلِ وَٱلۡأَنفُسِ وَٱلثَّمَرَٰتِۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتۡهُم مُّصِيبَةٞ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيۡهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَلَوَٰتٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡ وَرَحۡمَةٞۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُهۡتَدُونَ

mainSubject.label: Seeking help through patience and prayer; Allah's companionship with the patient; martyrs are alive not dead; divine testing through fear, hunger, loss; glad tidings for those who recite istirja' when afflicted; blessings and mercy upon the patient; they are the rightly guided

subordinateSubjects.label: Command: seek help through patience and prayer
Allah is with the patient (inna Allaha ma'a al-sabireen)
Prohibition: do not call martyrs dead; they are alive
Divine testing: fear, hunger, loss of wealth, lives, fruits
Istirja': inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
Salawat and rahmah from Rabb upon the patient

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Prohibition: do not say about those killed in Allah's way that they are dead.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتۡهُم مُّصِيبَةٞ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيۡهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Taught supplication: Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we return.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Patience (sabr) as primary spiritual resource in adversity
Martyrdom: alive in unseen realm despite apparent death
Istirja' as response to calamity: recognition of divine ownership and return

notes: Pass A pilot 9, passage 25/4. Core sabr passage. Contains taught supplication (istirja'). Establishes divine testing framework and martyr ontology. Links to sabr-patience, patience-haste topics.
